name: Act II · the roots — the opening
rule: every beat a datum; the season line reads seasons.json; the hold names the gesture. The roots — the humans — come next, with source: and consent:. The ledger (element 7) ticks on beats with achieve:; entries from earlier acts arrive already ticked (ticked:). A beat with clear: turns the page of the stream — a new chapter starts empty.

beats.line: the point where the thread pierces the ground — at rest, sixty to the minute
from below, grey and white: dew, after the fire — before any season has a colour
one becomes two — Líf, and Lífþrasir: the two who survived inside the tree
they stay under the ground, and hold it from beneath
— and in the corner of the frame, recognised: the two rings, the C, the cube that was taken out. The mark.
jnxmas — “You are part of the adventure anyway.”
Satish — “Sorry, I was occupied with lot of work. We can connect this weekend.”
Max — “I see most of these organizations as platforms that can connect to an audience of entrepreneurs and decision-makers.”
Victor — idealism. His first hackathon: weeks against the OCR wall, then Firecrawl, the crawler that read four thousand municipal documents
— and the roots not yet drawn: the ones who come next

hold.door: The tree is held from beneath.
hold.hint: the humans come next · any key, or touch
hold.after: — a hand. The roots grow from here.

source: Vafþrúðnismál 45 — Líf and Lífþrasir, who hide in Hoddmímis holt and live on the morning dew; the realm's own reading (assets/myth.md)
